data.summary:
Seeking senior level assignments in GCC Sales, Corporate Business Development/ Team Management with an organization of high repute.
Senior Sales & Business Development Leader with 16+ years of experience driving GCC sales, GTM strategy, corporate business development, and client acquisition across consulting, insurance, and financial services.
Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, building CXO-level relationships, and leading high-performing teams.
Recognized for consistently delivering growth, expanding market share, and positioning organizations as trusted partners in GCC markets.

responsibilities: Leading GCC account-based sales and new client onboarding.
Driving domestic client acquisition and managing OMP portfolio.
Spearheading Hyderabad eminence & events for brand positioning.
Leading GCC account-based sales and new client onboarding.
Driving domestic client acquisition and managing OMP portfolio.
Spearheading Hyderabad eminence & events for brand positioning.
Expanded GCC & GIC engagements in Risk Advisory.
Added new logos, across green dot.
Strengthened South India market presence in compliance & governance.
Enhanced client penetration across region and onboarded new client logos.
Acquired new clients and retained key accounts through CXO engagement.
Consistently overachieved sales targets; top-rated in ABG DAC Leadership program.
Handled large Power Sector Portfolio.

experience.company: Atlas Financial Research & Consulting Pvt. Ltd.
responsibilities: Delivered highest sales in company history, driving record topline growth.
New client acquisition + existing portfolio retention (Hunting & Farming)
Achieved 100%+ targets year-on-year.
Awarded Star Performer for outstanding sales results.
Expanded client base in AP & Telangana through sector-focused sales.
Handled a 12-member team.
Ranked #1 in South India for business acquisition (2012 to 2014).
Awarded for outstanding performance two consecutive years.
Increased market shared from 36%-67% in mid corporate business.
Awarded Employee of the Year (2010-11) for highest business generation.

Seeking senior level assignments in GCC Sales, Corporate Business Development/ Team Management with
an organization of high repute.
Executive Profile
Senior Sales & Business Development Leader with 16+ years of experience driving GCC sales, GTM strategy, corporate business development, and client acquisition across consulting, insurance, and financial services. Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, building CXO-level relationships, and leading high-performing teams. Recognized for consistently delivering growth, expanding market share, and positioning organizations as trusted partners in GCC markets.
